scope: The four-point divider at a fixed modern 2:1 setting. The screw clamps the pivot. The instrument opens and closes by hand. Thread adjustment is fixed during the demonstration.
gaps: No original leg length or quantitative calibration is established.
A precise translation of the sheet’s proportional settings and a Richter number remain unverified.
The 2:1 ratio here is a modern setting, not attributed to the drawing.

drive.justification: Two hands move the legs symmetrically around their shared screw. This symmetry is a presentation choice, not a gear.

motion.visitor_12s: Each leg rotates by 0.30 rad. Total included angle grows from 0.30 to0.90 rad. t is phase-local seconds. The points preserve their 2:1 separation ratio.

animation_notes: Do not animate a mechanism missing from the evidence.
Screw stays clamped at one pivot position. Do not slide the pivot or animate an unspecified thread.
Both leg hinges share the pin axis. They have separate manual inputs. No gearing is implied.
The pin local +Y is world +Z. The profile local rotations cancel the pin rest orientation.
